conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, favoring income and broad index exposure. Expect lower drawdowns but also limited upside potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretch growth, targeting ~4% per month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of higher potential drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month. It focuses on income-generating ETFs and broad indices, with minimal exposure to high-beta or leveraged assets. While prioritizing income and low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
